_comment: Spec §4.3 on-device / authoring confidence weights. See UNIFIED_FILTER_SPEC.md. Policy: keep (high) a NAMED or OFFICIAL trail; drop (low) anonymous urban footways, private, abandoned, informal, roads-mistagged-as-tracks, and sub-threshold stubs. 'Official' is GLOBAL: in_route_relation (OSM hiking route member) + network_national (iwn/nwn), plus optional per-country authoritative_match. in_official_whitelist now means 'merely inside a protected-area polygon' and is a weak +10 ('inside a park != a trail'), while a real register match is authoritative_match +40. Loaded by the authoring build (dev-only) and mirrored by ScoringWeights.default in TrailScoring.swift; both test suites pin these numbers.
